## Why runtime is WAITING (not a choice — an environment boundary)
The autonomous session runs in an isolated **Linux** sandbox: the device bridge is a
Linux VM with **no Windows toolchain**, **intermittent/no network**, and the **GUI is
masked** from screenshots. Terminals cannot be typed into (safety). Therefore Electron/
NSIS build, install, the running app, visual/computer-use/browser E2E, and live provider
health calls **cannot be executed or validated here**, and faking their PASS is forbidden.
The complete runtime plan lives in [`WINDOWS_NATIVE_EXECUTOR_HANDOFF.md`](./WINDOWS_NATIVE_EXECUTOR_HANDOFF.md).
